item.title: Davidsonville, Maryland
item.description: Davidsonville is a waterfront community on the Patuxent River in southern Anne Arundel County, offering boat ramps, parks, and a relaxed Chesapeake Bay lifestyle.

item.title: Gambrills, Maryland
item.description: Gambrills is a suburban community in southern Anne Arundel County with a mix of residential areas, shopping centers, and proximity to historic London Town.
